components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width action; the Roll button in the thumb zone.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:block;width:100%;min-height:52px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--accent-fill,#0a6be0);color:var(--on-accent,#fff);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(10,132,255,.28);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised-surface action for empty states and alerts.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:48px;padding:0 18px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2,#2c2c2e);color:var(--accent-text,#6cb4ff);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-secondary:active{opacity:.7}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Filters Row
components.description: Single row that opens the filters list sheet; summary and active count inline.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:8px 12px 8px 14px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#1c1c1e);color:var(--text-3,#a1a1a8);text-align:left;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-filters__text{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}.ds-filters__label{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text,#fff)}.ds-filters__sum{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2,#b4b4bb)}.ds-filters__count{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:24px;height:24px;padding:0 7px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--accent-fill,#0a6be0);color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}.ds-filters:active{background:var(--surface-2,#2c2c2e)}.ds-filters:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Option List
components.description: Drill-in option rows inside the Filters sheet, iOS Settings style.
components.css: .ds-options{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--surface-2,#2c2c2e);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.ds-options li+li .ds-opt{border-top:.5px solid var(--sep,rgba(84,84,88,.6))}.ds-opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:0 14px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--text,#fff);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:17px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-opt:active{background:var(--surface-3,#3a3a3c)}.ds-opt__class{flex:1;font-weight:800}.ds-opt__class::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--c);margin-right:10px;vertical-align:-1px}.ds-opt__count{color:var(--text-2,#b4b4bb);font-size:15px}.ds-opt__check{width:20px;color:var(--accent-text,#6cb4ff)}

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Pool switch: My Garage / All Cars.
components.css: .ds-seg{display:flex;padding:2px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface-2,#2c2c2e)}.ds-seg__opt{flex:1;min-height:34px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:none;color:var(--text-2,#b4b4bb);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-seg__opt[aria-checked=true]{background:var(--surface-3,#3a3a3c);color:var(--text,#fff);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}.ds-seg__opt:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-field__label{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-2,#b4b4bb);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;margin:0 4px 6px}.ds-field__input{display:block;width:100%;min-height:48px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2,#2c2c2e);color:var(--text,#fff);padding:0 14px;font:inherit;font-size:17px;caret-color:var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline:none}.ds-field__input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff)}

components.name: Roll Card
components.description: The roll result: uncropped 1340:752 photo on the radial floor, model, large badge, facts.
components.html:
Dodge Charger Daytona HEMI

C479

1969 · RWD · Epic · Classic Muscle
components.css: .ds-card{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#1c1c1e);color:var(--text,#fff);box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;max-width:360px}.ds-card__photo{aspect-ratio:1340/752;background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 100%,#2a2a30,#111114)}.ds-card__body{padding:14px 18px 18px}.ds-card__model{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:26px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.15}.ds-card__facts{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--text-2,#b4b4bb);line-height:1.4}.ds-badge{display:inline-flex;border:2px solid var(--c);border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;line-height:1}.ds-badge__class{background:var(--c);color:#000;padding:7px 10px}.ds-badge__pi{background:#111;color:#fff;padding:7px 10px}

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Three-tab material bar; active tab in Link Blue.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;padding:6px 8px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg,#000) 82%,transparent);backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(20px);border-top:.5px solid var(--sep,rgba(84,84,88,.6))}.ds-tab{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;min-height:44px;border:0;background:none;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-3,#a1a1a8);cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-tab[aria-current=page]{color:var(--accent-text,#6cb4ff)}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Toast
components.description: Bottom toast above the Roll button in surface-2 material.
components.css: .ds-toast{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--surface-2,#2c2c2e);color:var(--text,#fff);border:.5px solid var(--sep,rgba(84,84,88,.6));border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.55);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:15px;max-width:340px}.ds-toast__btn{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 10px;background:var(--accent-fill,#0a6be0);color:#fff;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-toast__btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0a84ff);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
The app is a native iOS app in a PWA's clothes. It uses true black ground, grouped surfaces in three tonal steps, hairline separators and SF system text. Nothing is decorated. The roll result is the one moment with weight: a rounded card with an uncropped car photo on a soft radial floor, the model name in bold, and the FH6 class badge below it. Everything else is a fast, plain list.

Color is rationed. The only hues on screen are the FH6 class colors, which identify a car's class just as the game's garage tiles do, and one system blue for actions. Dark mode is primary. Light mode mirrors it with iOS grouped-background values and keeps the same roles.

Density is iOS-standard: 17px body text, 44px minimum touch targets, 16px screen gutters, and a 640px max width so the layout stays a phone column on larger screens.
keyCharacteristics: True black ground with #1c1c1e / #2c2c2e / #3a3a3c grouped surfaces and 0.5px separators.
SF system type only, with large titles at 34px bold.
Class colors and one blue are the only chroma.
Car photos always show the whole car, in a 1340:752 frame.
One signature motion: the roll reveal.

rules.name: The Two Sources Rule
rules.body: Chroma comes only from a class color or the action blue. No other hue enters the UI. Car photos are the only exception.

rules.name: The Fill Versus Text Rule
rules.body: Blue behind white text is `accent-fill`. Blue as text is `accent-text`. Never put white text on raw `system-blue`, and never put `accent-fill` text on a dark surface.

rules.name: The Black Letter Rule
rules.body: Class letters are always black on their class color. A new class color earns its place only if black text on it clears 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Eleven Point Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text goes below 11px. Tab labels sit at that floor.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. Never place a kicker or eyebrow label above a title. Uppercase 13px is reserved for iOS section headers on groups and fields.

rules.name: The Tonal First Rule
rules.body: Separate things by surface step and hairline before reaching for a shadow. A shadow means the element floats above the list: the result, an alert or a toast.

rules.name: The Whole Car Rule
rules.body: Car photos always render uncropped (`object-fit: contain`) inside a 1340:752 frame on the radial photo floor. This applies to the roll card hero and to garage thumbnails. Never crop a car to fill a box.

dos: Do print class letters in black on the class color. Check that any new class color clears 4.5:1.
Do use `accent-fill` behind white labels and `accent-text` for blue text.
Do show every car whole: 1340:752, `object-fit: contain`, on the radial photo floor.
Do keep Filters as one row that opens a list and drills into options, iOS Settings style.
Do keep the roll reveal as the only expressive motion. Use 0.15–0.22s ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`) for state changes, and fall back to opacity under reduced motion.
Do put toasts at the bottom, above the Roll button, in surface-2 material.
Do keep touch targets at 44px or more and functional text at 11px or more.
donts: Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't style a non-control, such as a label, a value or a static tag, as a fake button. Don't dress a control as something it isn't. Buttons look like iOS buttons, rows look like rows.
Don't bring back wrapping filter chips.
Don't add hues outside the class colors and the action blue.
Don't crop car photos or use `object-fit: cover` on them.
Don't add new motion signatures, such as page transitions, bouncing lists or parallax.
